description: Batch text to speech (TTS): turn up to 20 separate text items into WAV audio in one paid call using the 10 standard voices (no speed, steps or personas). Returns JSON with one entry per item: audio_base64 (WAV), duration_s, format and sample_rate. Best for queues, notifications, scripted sequences and content batches. Costs $0.005 for 1-500 total chars and $0.005 for 501-2000 total chars. Charged only for a 200 that carries audio: the service refuses with 400 before payment (charged:false) text with no letter or digit, text whose script does not match lang, non-Latin text without lang, speed outside 0.7-2.0, steps outside 1-100, or an unknown voice, lang or response_format; audio that fails its post-synthesis check answers 502 with charged:false.

items.description: Array of text items; total text across all items must be <= 2000 chars
